construction.map: delta_w = K * delta_m elementwise, K = -lr beta1 / (bc1 D), D = sqrt((beta2 v + (1 - beta2) c^2) / bc2) + 1e-8, c = clipped first-batch gradient; K independent of exp_avg and identical across arms; never divided by
construction.reference: dm_M = -0.1 m (anchor exp_avg, float64); analytic write v_M = K * dm_M
per_group_steps: draw q ~ N(0, I) float64 in EXP_AVG coordinates over the 18,911,616 flat coordinates from torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed), one draw per seed in flat order; take the group's slice
project under the write metric: q_perp = q - (<K q, v_M> / ||v_M||^2) * dm_M  (K q_perp orthogonal to v_M within the group, exactly)
scale under the write metric: dm_R = (||v_M|| / ||K q_perp||) * q_perp  (||K dm_R|| = ||v_M|| within the group)
apply exp_avg <- float32(float64(exp_avg) + dm_R); exp_avg_sq, step, weights, scheduler, stream untouched
construction.targets: DERIVED at run time: dW_M(1) = W_M(1) - W_C(1) from the sha-pinned FMEL2 e1e-1 h = 1 snapshot and the fresh C h = 1 state (digest == locked FMEL2 C h = 1); its norm and nine group shares are the preflight targets; the rounded L76553 values are display references only
construction.analytic_v_realized: per arm: ||dW_r(1) - K dm_r|| / ||K dm_r|| with dm_r the realized float32 exp_avg delta (and with the intended float64 dm_R); for M: ||dW_M(1) - v_M|| / ||v_M||; recorded, no bar
construction.state_rounding_desk_bound: write-space image of the exp_avg rounding <= 10 * 2^-24 |v_M,i| per coordinate, <= 6e-7 of the matched norm in total (three orders below the 1e-3 tolerance)
descriptive: max |dm_R| and the 0.5 / 0.9 / 0.99 / 0.999 quantiles of |dm_R| per arm
per-group write-metric effective dimension n_eff = (sum K^2)^2 / sum K^4 and the count of coordinates with exp_avg_sq = 0
construction.withdrawn: L76553's isotropic draw in write space inverted by delta_m = delta_w / K (inverse-preconditions the draw; withdrawn by this amendment)
